The '''2023–24 Boston College Eagles men's basketball team''' represented [[Boston College]] during the [[2023–24 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Eagles, led by third-year head coach [[Earl Grant (basketball)|Earl Grant]], played their home games at the [[Conte Forum]] as members of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]].

The Eagles started the season with four straight wins, including a win over rivals [[2023–24 Harvard Crimson men's basketball team|Harvard]]. However, their fortunes changed as they entered their early-season tournament, the [[Hall of Fame Classic (basketball tournament)|Hall of Fame Classic]]. The team lost both of their games in the tournament before defeating [[2023–24 Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball team|Vanderbilt]] in the [[ACC–SEC Challenge]]. They had an overtime loss to [[2023–24 NC State Wolfpack men's basketball team|NC State]] to open their ACC season, before winning their remaining four non-conference games. They won two of their next five ACC games, including a loss at twenty-first ranked [[2023–24 Clemson Tigers men's basketball team|Clemson]]. The team then went on a streak of losing two games, followed by winning two games for eight total games. Losses in this streak included fourth-ranked [[2023–24 North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball team|North Carolina]] and ninth-ranked [[2023–24 Duke Blue Devils men's basketball team|Duke]]. The Eagles finished the ACC regular season with four straight losses followed by two wins.

The Eagles finished the season 20–16, 8–12 in [[2023–24 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to finish in eleventh place. As the eleventh seed the [[2024 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]], they defeated [[2023–24 Miami Hurricanes men's basketball team|Miami]] in the First Round, and Clemson in the Second Round before losing to [[2023–24 Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball team|Virginia]] in the Quarterfinals. They received an at-large bid to the [[2024 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] as an un-seeded team. They defeated third-seed [[2023–24 Providence Friars men's basketball team|Providence]] in the First Round before losing at [[2023–24 UNLV Runnin' Rebels basketball team|UNLV]] in the Second Round to end their season.

==Previous season==
The [[2022–23 Boston College Eagles men's basketball team|Eagles]] finished the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2022–23 season]] 16–17, 9–11 in [[2022–23 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to finish in 10th place. In the [[2023 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]], they defeated [[2022–23 Louisville Cardinals men's basketball team|Louisville]] before losing to  [[2022–23 North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball team|North Carolina]] in the second round.
